description: Source code for a Zephyr display driver for Intel multiboot framebuffer, handling framebuffer initialization, pixel format, orientation, and read/write operations.

methods.name: framebuf_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format for the framebuffer, supports only ARGB_8888.

methods.name: framebuf_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets the display orientation, supports only normal orientation.

methods.name: framebuf_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and pixel format.

methods.name: framebuf_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the framebuffer at specified x,y coordinates.

methods.name: framebuf_read
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer at specified x,y coordinates.

methods.name: multiboot_framebuf_init
methods.description: Initializes the framebuffer using multiboot info, centers the framebuffer if available.
